text:
maria: FYI opened PR to add streaming SDK example and a short migration note for the v2 client. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4215

maria: CI/docs-preview is flaky again — preview returns 500 intermittently and that blocks auto-merge. Not sure if it’s the preview server or the build step. Anyone seen this today? :confused:

sam: I saw a couple timeouts earlier. Error looks like the preview service reported `GET /preview 500` after hugo finished serving. Can you paste the failing check output?

maria: here’s the relevant tail from the check:
```
ERROR: preview-server: upstream read: connection reset by peer
Task: upload-artifacts failed: 1/3 attempts
Status: 500 Internal Server Error
```

docs-bot: docs-preview job rerun requested by @maria — queued (build #2031) :gear:

jordan: We should avoid letting transient preview failures block trivial docs PRs. Two quick options: (1) make the preview check non-blocking for certain paths (links/examples/mkdocs docs-only), or (2) add a retry wrapper in CI so transient network hiccups auto-retry before failing. I can add a small retry step in the preview workflow.

kevin: +1 for retry wrapper. Also — auto-merge is currently gated on all checks passing (including preview). If we change branch protection to allow non-blocking status checks for previews, we can keep it required for unit tests.

maria: ok — this PR is purely docs + example snippet, no code. If we make preview non-blocking for `docs/**` and `examples/**`, that would unfreeze auto-merge for things like link fixes.

sam: we also have CODEOWNERS auto-requesting a reviewer who is OOO this week, so even if checks pass, merge waits. We should rotate reviewers or use team-based ownership.

maria: good call. Current CODEOWNERS has a specific person path. Example from repo: 
```
# current
/docs/sdk/python/** @lee-stable 
/docs/migrations/** @lee-stable
```

maria: If we change to a team owner: `@redwood/docs` then requests go to the team queue and someone can pick it up.

jordan: Agreed. Proposal:
- Add CI retry to docs-preview with 3 attempts and backoff
- Update branch-protection to mark `docs-preview` as non-blocking for `docs/**` and `examples/**` via a new GitHub check name `docs-preview-nonblocking`
- Replace single-user CODEOWNERS entries for docs paths with `@redwood/docs` team

kevin: Sounds good. Small note: for migration guides we probably still want a named SME on the PR to check accuracy. Team ownership + a recommended reviewer label works well.

maria: I’ll update the PR to add a short PR body that marks it `docs-only` and add the `recommended-reviewer: @sdk-sme` label. Can someone open a tiny PR to switch CODEOWNERS to the team? I don’t have perms for that repo path.

sam: I can do the CODEOWNERS PR today. jordan — can you add the retry step to the preview workflow? I’ll follow up on branch protection with infra.

jordan: Yep, I’ll open a patch for the workflow (adds: `retry: attempts: 3, delay: 10s`). I’ll ping here when it’s up.

maria: thanks all — re-run now passed and docs-preview showed the new snippet. If the CODEOWNERS + non-blocking check land we can turn auto-merge back on for docs-only. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: build #2031 finished: success (preview available at https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/changes/4215)

kevin: Action items captured: sam -> CODEOWNERS PR, jordan -> preview retry workflow, infra -> branch-protection toggle. maria -> label PR `docs-only` + recommended reviewer.

maria: I’ll wait 24h for infra/owners then merge if green. Thanks! :sparkles:
